requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot

requirements.requirement: Bay tray standing in that spot
requirements.evidence: bay:0#0,1#bay0 at 0,1,0 stem hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid (Full bay tray, south bay) bolted to all three cells, meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built triangular cluster of three full bases at 0,0 / 1,0 / 1,1 leaving 0,1 empty. Placed full bay tray hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid in 0,1 (k0) – a bay requires three adjacent cells and is verified clear with no mesh clash.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
